info.title: Philippine electricity rates (prototype)
info.summary: DOE's monthly rate sheet as static JSON: utilities, monthly rates, medians, source checks, and NEA's power-interruption indices.
info.description: Every endpoint is a static file: no key, no rate limit, cacheable. Files regenerate when the pipeline runs. Join to LGUs on PSGC codes. Bulk CSV/Parquet and a Frictionless datapackage are listed in /api/catalog.json.

get.description: Master list v0 with each utility's latest rate per class.
Monthly residential, commercial and industrial rates and the generation charge.
All series in one file, month-aligned (drives the map).

example.note: null = NDA, blank, or a value flagged by QA (see /api/rates/<id>.json)

get.description: Unweighted medians per class and month.

example.note: Median across utilities with a value that month (NDA excluded). Unweighted: each utility counts once, regardless of customers served.

get.description: DOE's figures compared with utilities' own rate documents, with evidence locations.

sources.name: Meralco
sources.how: Rates archive page lists each month's PDFs; the residential-bills table prints PHP/kWh per consumption level.

not_automated.name: 54 utilities linked to Facebook
not_automated.why: Facebook pages can't be read without logging in, and Meta's terms forbid automated collection without its permission. Until a sanctioned route exists (Graph API Page Public Content Access, utilities connecting their Pages, or a DOE filing), a person saves the month's rate post into data/inbox/<utility_id>/ and the same image reader takes it from there.

get.description: NEA's quarterly SAIFI and SAIDI for every electric cooperative, year to date, with medians and NEA's compliance flags.

example.source: National Electrification Administration, Compliance Report on the Performance of ECs (Appendix B)
example.basis: Year to date: figures rise through each year and restart each Q1, so Q4 is the full year. Inferred; NEA does not say.
example.covers: Electric cooperatives only. ERC does not publish these indices for private utilities.

Utility.description: One distribution utility in DOE's rate sheet (master list v0).

utility_id.description: Stable ID, issued once from the name DOE prints.

doe_name.description: Name exactly as DOE prints it (usually the acronym).

name.description: Full name, from the coverage source. Empty if unmatched.

du_type.description: Private investor-owned utility or electric cooperative.

psgc_province_codes.description: Semicolon-separated 10-digit PSGC province codes of the franchise area.

psgc_independent_city_codes.description: Served cities that belong to no province (HUCs, ICCs, NCR).

doe_source_url.description: The link in DOE's SOURCES column.

latest.description: Most recent month with a plausible value, per class.

rates_url.description: Path of this utility's rates file.

Rates.description: Monthly series for one utility, PHP/kWh, as DOE entered them.

residential.description: [month, PHP/kWh] pairs, months with a value only

commercial.description: [month, PHP/kWh] pairs, months with a value only

industrial.description: [month, PHP/kWh] pairs, months with a value only

generation.description: [month, PHP/kWh] pairs, months with a value only

nda_months.description: Months DOE marked NDA (no data available).

flagged_by_qa.description: Values left out of the series as implausible (outside 1-40 PHP/kWh). Still in rates.csv.

Panel.description: Every utility's series in one file, aligned to `months`.

series.description: class -> utility_id -> values (same order as months; null = no plausible value)

Medians.description: Unweighted medians across utilities with a value that month.

counts.description: class -> month -> number of utilities in the national median

Check.description: One DOE figure compared with the utility's own document.

doe_cell_url.description: Opens the exact cell in DOE's Google Sheet.

mirror.description: Copy of the file kept by this site.

row_box.description: x0, top, x1, bottom as fractions of the page

ReliabilityQuarter.description: One cooperative, one quarter, as NEA printed it (year to date).

saifi.description: Sustained interruptions per customer, year to date. Null where NEA printed no figure.

saidi_minutes.description: Minutes without power per customer, year to date.

saifi_status.description: NEA's flag: C (compliant) or NC (non-compliant; also given when no data was sent).

missing.description: NEA's code where it printed no figure (dns, nds, nda, inc), else empty.

page.description: Page of NEA's report the row is on.

Reliability.description: SAIFI and SAIDI per electric cooperative per quarter, from NEA's compliance reports.

standards.description: NEA's yearly standards per customer, on-grid and off-grid.

medians.description: period -> median SAIFI and SAIDI across cooperatives with a figure (unweighted)

issues.description: utility_id -> year-to-date figures that fall within a year (questions for NEA)

Municipalities.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of municipalities and cities, with the utilities serving each.
